title: Action with an Oracle Choice Tape
statement: Let $a$ be an action on $k+1$ Boolean work tapes with state set $S$. Extend it to $k+2$ work tapes and state set $S\sqcup\{0,1,2\}$ by inserting at position $k$ an action that writes a blank and moves its head one cell to the right. Preserve the input-head movement and output, and tag any successor state from $S$ with the left injection; if $a$ has no successor state, the extended action also has none.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action on $k+1$ Boolean work tapes with states in $S$
